channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont welcomed fifteen point six million visitors in twenty twenty-five, generating four point one billion dollars in spending. This supported over thirty-one thousand jobs and contributed eight point five percent to the state's GDP. Canadian visitation dropped twenty-eight percent, affecting tourism numbers.

Vermont ski resorts are optimistic about Canadian visitors returning after the mid-term elections. Killington Resort will open Tuesday and has invested eighty million dollars in upgrades. Resorts are ready to make snow as temperatures drop this season.

More than seventy Vermont students gathered in Rutland for a youth summit on education. They discussed topics like race, gender, and rural schools with educators and legislators. Organizers aim to increase student voice in education policy.

A Brandon man was arrested for stealing one thousand three hundred dollars in hunting gear from Walmart. Tanner Grandfield faces felony and misdemeanor charges including giving false information to police. He was ordered to stay away from Walmart after his release.
